title: Card 1: sab App ek hi Redis ginti dekhte hain. Chhathi request pe 429

boxes.title: Redis (ginti yahin)
lines: 60 sec baad key khud mit jaati

callouts.red: Pehle har App apni ginti rakhta tha: 5 + 4 = 9 andar
callouts.green: Ab dono App ek hi Redis ginti dekhte, 6 pe mana

callouts.red: Ginti DB me rakhte to har request pe disk aur lock
callouts.green: Bahut dheema hota. Redis RAM me hai, ~1 ms

callouts.red: Sticky LB se Arpan ko hamesha ek hi App pe bhejte?
callouts.green: Wo App gira to Arpan ki ginti bhi saath gayi

callouts.red: Minute ke kinare pe 5 aur agle minute ke shuru me 5: 2 sec me 10 andar
callouts.green: Ye fixed window ki kamzori hai. Isliye asli me token bucket lagate
